title: Review Forge scope
description: Frozen review scope and intent for one feature_dir. Written once by the host in the scope command; every reviewer and voter reads it and none re-infers it. scope_sha256 is the SHA-256 of this file's bytes.

ref.description: PR number or URL, branch name, commit range, or empty for files and working_tree.

resolved_by.description: Which scope rule produced this scope.

base_ref.description: Comparison ref, or empty when target.kind is files.

review_files.description: Repo-relative paths under review. Findings may only anchor here.

why.description: What the reviewer needs this file for, e.g. caller of refresh().

context_files.description: Read-only reference files. Issues seen here go to out_of_scope_notes, never findings.

patch_file.description: Path of the frozen diff, normally scope.patch in feature_dir.

statement.description: One paragraph: what this change is meant to do.

status.description: confirmed: the user accepted the statement. inferred: the sources left no ambiguity and the user was not asked.
